test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What will be the average of the odd numbers from 21 to 81?
solution:
Formula used:

The sum of (1 + 2 +.....+ n) = (n(n+1))/(2)

Average = The sum of all number/(Total number)

Calculation:

The sum of odd numbers between 21 to 81,

21 + 23 + 25 + ..........+ 81

⇒ (21 + 0) + (21 + 2) + (21 + 4) +...........+ (21 + 60)

⇒ {21 + 21 + 21 +............(31 times)} + 0 + 2 + 4 + ...........+60

⇒ 31(21) + (0 + 2 + 4 + 6 + ...........+ 60)

⇒ 651 + 2(1 + 2 + 3 +......+ 30)

⇒ 651 + 2[(30(30+1))/(2)]

⇒ 651 + 930

⇒ 1581

Average = The sum of all number/(Total number)

⇒ Average = (1581)/31

⇒ Average = 51

∴ The average of all odd numbers from 21 to 81 is 51.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Concept used:**

If the series is in A.P, then

Average of the series = (First term + last term)/2

Calculation:

The consecutive odd numbers are:

21 + 23 + 25 + ..........+ 81

So this series is in A.P

Average of all odd numbers from 21 to 81 = (21 + 81)/2

⇒ 102/2 = 51

∴ The average of all odd numbers from 21 to 81 is 51.
